findings.evidence: All 30 product pages have explicit dimensional guidance (pb-001 is defined in src/data/productGuides.ts; remaining 29 in catalog detail JSON). However, 17 product pages link only to the general blade-product-families article.
findings.next: Prioritize application-specific buying questions for steel rolling, corrugated, doctor, chipper and crusher families. Use confirmed drawings/process information; do not invent tolerances, performance or machine compatibility.

findings.evidence: rs-001 includes matched slitter knife sets as a secondary keyword while sk-001 and its children cover slitting knives. The catalog deliberately treats rolling shear and slitting as separate product families.
findings.next: Review actual cutting method, processed material and knife-set arrangement before revising overlapping terms. A keyword overlap alone does not prove search cannibalization.

findings.evidence: Ten family pages and twenty subtype pages have unique primary topics; child pages link to parents and all products receive incoming static links.
findings.next: Keep family pages focused on selection among types and subtype pages focused on geometry, mounting and quotation inputs; avoid copying the same buying explanation to both.

findings.evidence: LanguageProvider loads dictionaries on the client and uses a lang query parameter. Static route generation emits one English page per canonical route.
findings.next: Treat nine language packs as interface localization. Independent multilingual indexing requires a separate approved URL/content strategy; do not claim nine localized indexable versions.

findings.evidence: Static HTML now includes the React body, while src/main.tsx uses createRoot rather than hydrateRoot.
findings.next: Observe first load, language restoration and navigation in the actual browser before changing startup behavior. Current tests confirm HTML content, not continuity during client mounting.
